description:
"In every quiet cup, a deep tradition lives on.
This guide explores the world of Japanese tea—from its varieties and flavors to the rich cultural practice of the tea ceremony.
You’ll learn the basics of sadō (the Way of Tea), the art of preparation, and the spirit of hospitality that lies within each movement.
Perfect for beginners, this book invites you to discover the beauty of Japanese tea culture in your everyday life."
name: The World of Japanese Tea Through the Way of Tea
